_meta.description: Canonical friend database for the Bella content engine. v2.0 supersedes the SEO/GBP premise: friends are now framed around missed calls, after-hours bookings, OpenTable cover fees, the language gap, and the Quandoo exit. Active roster is 60% Australian / 40% international (see top-level `roster`). Before/after arcs for existing friends still reference the v1 GBP framing and will be reframed in the premise-pivot-v2 follow-up.

sensory_hooks: Lamb on the spit turning slow, oregano smoke drifting onto The Parade by noon.
The clack of worry beads on the bar while Kostas waits for the dinner rush.
Saganaki hitting the pan — the flame, the 'Opa!' from a regular.
Yiayia's phyllo stretched paper-thin across the whole kitchen bench at 7am.
The Norwood Friday-night crowd spilling off The Parade as the bouzouki playlist starts.
friends.story_angle: A family Greek taverna stranded on Quandoo as the platform shuts down — needing a replacement booking line that answers in Greek before the Glendi rush

before_bella.operational: Stranded on Quandoo as it shuts down, and missing after-hours calls during the Greek-community dinner trade — Yiayia answering in Greek while the English bookings ring out.
before_bella.personal: Kostas keeps the Quandoo shutdown email in his apron pocket like a parking ticket. Yiayia hasn't seen it. He doesn't want her to think the family business is the one being switched off.

after_bella.operational: Migrated to a commission-free line that answers in Greek and English. The Saturday glendi books itself; Kostas is back on the floor pouring wine instead of chasing the phone.
after_bella.personal: Yiayia keeps answering the regulars in Greek. The line takes the rest. The family name stays on the door — and the door stays open.

operational: Greek Orthodox Easter — the single biggest booking week of the year; after-hours demand floods in and the calls ring out.
Adelaide Glendi festival drives a dinner surge; bookings lost to venues whose phones get answered.
Quandoo closes (migration deadline 30 Sep 2026); Thea needs a replacement booking system before the spring rush.
personal: Yiayia is the real boss and Kostas knows it; his job is to make sure the phyllo, not the platform, is what decides Saturday.
Kostas remembers every regular's order; the worry beads come out when the phone doesn't.

friends.personality: Big, warm, loud laugh — feeds everyone, remembers every regular's order. Proud of the family name. Yiayia is the real boss and he knows it.
